incident-bot: PAGED — service=canary-inference severity=P1 — 503 spike detected across canary cluster. PagerDuty incident: https://pd.example/incidents/INC123456 — paging oncall (Marta)
Marta: acked — looking now. seeing 40% 5xx on canary nodes in us-west-2. any deploys in last 15m?
Alex: I rolled the canary w/ new runtime build ~10m ago (runtimes/2026.03.15/fastpath). Noted minor kv-cache warning during smoke.
Jordan: routing telemetry shows error rate jumps at ~1719009400, coincide w/ canary traffic shift.
Marta: ok, isolating canary traffic. I'll pause rollout. Can someone confirm rollback recipe?
deploy-bot: Incoming deploy action: rollout-id=rl-20260315-17 status=partial. To pause: `rbctl rollout pause rl-20260315-17`
Alex: pausing now.
Alex: `rbctl rollout pause rl-20260315-17` -> accepted :white_check_mark:
Marta: confirmed pause. continuing triage. Error traces show model kvcache miss leading to NPE in runtime kernel on quant path. stack sample: `runtime/kernel/kv_cache.cpp:238: null pointer deref`
Jordan: that NPE is new in the fastpath branch — regression in kernel selection. I can patch, but hotfix risk is higher than rolling back. Recommend rollback to previous stable canary.
Marta: agree. prepare rollback plan and customer impact note. Katie, any user-facing support hits?
Katie: support dashboard: 12 open tickets referencing 503 on embeddings endpoint, mostly small customers. No enterprise SLA pages yet. I'm drafting a status blurb for affected customers.
Alex: initiating rollback to commit abc123 (last known good). Rollback command:```bash
rbctl rollout rollback rl-20260315-17 --to-commit abc123 --force
```
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id jb-9987). Estimated completion 3m. Logs: https://logs.example/s/rl-20260315-17/jb-9987
Marta: watching metrics. canary 5xx dropping from 42% -> 6% within 90s. Good signal.
Jordan: confirm KV cache opt disabled in abc123. Kernel path reverts to stable.
Katie: updating support thread: "We observed elevated 503s after a canary rollback is in progress; rollback underway and services are recovering. Will update once fully validated."
Marta: routing restored to stable after rollback complete. Observability shows error rate normalized. PD: acknowledge -> resolved? need final check from Ops-Lead before closing.
Ops-Lead: thanks all. Quick postmortem notes: cause = kernel selection regression in fastpath quant code triggered by runtime config; mitigation = paused rollout + rollback; next steps = block fastpath runtime on canary until patch available, add canary smoke that asserts kvcache non-null, add targeted unit test.
Marta: filing incident ticket with timeline and linking PRs. Who will own the follow-up? Alex/Jordan?
Alex: I will own kernel PR and add tests. ETA 1 day for patch, then small canary with stricter health gates.
Jordan: I'll add a gating check to rollout controller to detect abnormal 5xx delta during initial ramp and auto-pause.
Katie: I'll send a brief status update to affected customers and close the support thread once we confirm no new incidents in 2h.
Marta: handing off to daytime oncall Ops-Lead for monitoring and closure. Thanks team. :clap:
incident-bot: PD incident INC123456 marked resolved by Marta at 1719013380
